6.1, where cross sectional area is A, v_{0}.  The velocity of electron just the end of contraction at point B, where cross sectional area is 2A, is v_{1}. Find the correct option. 
<img>
 <img> a)
 v1 < v_{0}b)
 v_{1} = v_{0}c)
 v_{1} > v_{0}d)
  <eqn> 
Key: c 
Hint:As the electrons comes near the throat, positive charges are induced on the throat. The induced charges attract the electron and velocity increases. So v1 > v_{0}.
